[Big Step!] Russia and Ukraine Agree to a [Large Prisoner Swap] After Abu Dhabi Talks
caption:
🕊️ Russia and Ukraine agree to a large prisoner swap

Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war after two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, both sides said on Wednesday. These were the first direct talks between the two countries in nine months.

🔹 The swap was confirmed by Russia's chief negotiator Vladimir Medinsky and Ukraine's Rustem Umerov. The exact numbers are still being finalised.
🔹 US envoy Jared Kushner called it the "biggest humanitarian release of prisoners" of the war.
🔹 No deal was reached on a ceasefire, territory or security guarantees. US envoys Kushner and Steve Witkoff then met President Putin in Moscow and President Zelensky in Ireland, and say a new round of talks is planned.

💬 Do you think these talks can bring the war closer to an end? 👇

Sources: AP, Reuters, ABC News

headline: [Global Outage!] Microsoft Outlook and Teams Go Down for [5+ Hours]
caption:
💻 Microsoft Outlook and Teams down for hours

A major Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft services for more than five hours on Thursday, Reuters reported. Problems began around 12:30 p.m. US Eastern time, and Microsoft said users in any region could be affected.

🔹 Problem reports for Outlook on Downdetector peaked at more than 138,000, according to Reuters.
🔹 Microsoft said a number of servers became unexpectedly unavailable because of elevated load, mainly hitting Exchange Online email.
🔹 Microsoft said it was returning servers to service and moving traffic, and warned that recovery would be gradual as users reconnect.

💬 Were you affected by the Microsoft outage? 👇

Sources: Reuters, ABC News

headline: [Tensions Rise!] Iran Says It Hit a [US Radar] in Bahrain
sub: The claim has not been independently verified
caption:
⚠️ Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain

Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said on Friday that they targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. Iran's state news agency IRNA reported the statement. AP and Al Jazeera said the claim could not be independently verified, and the US and Bahrain did not comment straight away.

🔹 The IRGC said it was a reply to an attack on a telecom tower in Sirik, a port city in southern Iran, on Thursday.
🔹 According to Reuters, it is Iran's first claimed attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September.
🔹 Bahrain hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The IRGC warned it is ready to act again.

💬 Do you think talks can stop the tension from growing? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Reuters

#GlobalEye #Iran #Bahrain #USA #MiddleEast #WorldNews
photo_needed: A US military radar or US Navy base in Bahrain, or an IRGC missile launch photo. A map-style image of Bahrain and Iran also works (no people needed).

headline: [New Twist!] Trump Says [Tim Cook] Should Replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
sub: Huang agrees to testify before Congress
caption:
💻 Trump says Tim Cook should lead Nvidia

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Apple's Tim Cook should become the new CEO of Nvidia, after Jensen Huang stepped down. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that there is "only one man" to take Huang's place and called it "A Legend replaces a Legend!"

🔹 Nvidia has named its finance chief, Colette Kress, as interim CEO while its board looks for a permanent leader.
🔹 Tim Cook stepped down as Apple CEO in September and is now executive chairman of Apple's board.
🔹 Huang has agreed to testify before US lawmakers in a closed-door session by Thanksgiving, House Foreign Affairs Committee chairman Brian Mast said.

💬 Who do you think should lead Nvidia next? 👇

Sources: NBC News, Fox Business, TechCrunch

#GlobalEye #Nvidia #TimCook #JensenHuang #Trump #Tech
photo_needed: Tim Cook, face clearly visible (e.g. at an Apple event). A photo of Tim Cook with Trump also works.

headline: [Cuba Warning!] Trump Says He Wants to [Get Cuba Done] Before Leaving Office
sub: He says he would consider military force
caption:
🌎 Trump Says He Wants to "Get Cuba Done" Before Leaving Office

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he wants to "get Cuba done" before he leaves office in 2029. Speaking in a radio interview with host Hugh Hewitt, he said he would consider using military force against Cuba and that his team is "watching it very closely."

🔹 Politico reported this is the first time Trump has given a timeline for possible action on Cuba.
🔹 Trump said Secretary of State Marco Rubio, whose parents are from Cuba, "would love to do it."
🔹 Since January, the US has blocked most oil shipments to Cuba, which has led to blackouts and food and fuel shortages. Cuban officials have said the island is ready for any attack.

💬 What do you think will happen next between the US and Cuba? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, Politico, The Hill

#GlobalEye #Cuba #USA #Trump #WorldNews #Politics
photo_needed: Donald Trump, face clearly visible (a recent photo). A photo of Havana, Cuba with the Cuban flag also works.

headline: [Shock Collapse!] India All Out for [89] as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs
sub: Matt Henry takes 6 wickets, Will Young hits 125
caption:
🏏 India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs

New Zealand beat India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui, on Friday. New Zealand made 333, and India were bowled out for just 89 in reply.

🔹 Fast bowler Matt Henry took 6 wickets for 27 runs. Reuters reported he took three wickets in his first over, including Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli.
🔹 Will Young scored 125 from 108 balls, his fifth ODI hundred.
🔹 India still lead the five-match series 2-1 (the third match was washed out by rain). The last match is on Sunday at the same ground.

💬 What went wrong for India today? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, Reuters, ESPNcricinfo

photo_needed: Matt Henry (New Zealand bowler) celebrating a wicket, face clearly visible. A New Zealand team celebration photo also works.

headline: [Big Homecoming!] Pope Leo Returns to the Peru City He Led as [Bishop]
sub: Up to 1 million expected at his Mass
caption:
🙏 Pope Leo Returns to the Peru City He Led as Bishop

Pope Leo XIV arrived in Chiclayo, Peru, on Friday for an outdoor Mass in the city where he served as bishop for eight years. Local officials said up to 1 million people could attend.

🔹 Before becoming pope, Leo (born Robert Prevost in Chicago) worked in Peru for about 20 years as a missionary priest and bishop.
🔹 In Lima on Wednesday, about 3 million people came out to see him, the biggest crowd of his papacy so far, Reuters reported.
🔹 Peru is the last stop of his 12-day South America trip, after Argentina and Uruguay. He stays in the Chiclayo area until Sunday.

💬 Have you ever seen the Pope in person? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AP
